VM - Variable Info.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Returns information about the specified variable. If an alias is used to refer to a variable, VI returns actual properties of a variable associated with the alias.
Also see VarMan overview.

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies a handle of the variable context where a desired variable resides. In order to get information on a global variable, pass value of -1 to VC Handle or keep it unwired. VC Handle is ignored if name_spec refers to a variable by an alias.
name_spec defines the name specifier of the target variable. Usually, this is merely a variable name; however, additional options are available. See the Referring to variables topic for details.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
var VC Handle returns a handle of context where the specified variable resides. It can differ from VC Handle, if name_spec refers to a variable by an alias.
var name returns an actual name of the specified variable.
alias returns an alias associated with the specified variable or empty string if the variable doesn't have an alias.
var type returns the data type of the specified variable.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
has history returns TRUE if the specified variable has a history attached.
